content1:
An object is said to be in motion if it changes its position with time. Motion is of different types:
1) Rectilinear motion (a car moving on a straight road),
2) Circular motion (the earth moving around the sun),
3) Rotational motion (spinning of a top), and
4) Periodic motion (a pendulum, swing).
content2:
Motion is always relative. For example, if you are sitting in a moving bus, you are at rest with respect to the seat but in motion with respect to the trees outside.
PYQs:
• If you are sitting in a moving train, in what sense are you at rest and in what sense are you in motion?
• Why is motion relative? Explain with an example.
